entities.name: Alonzo de Santa Cruz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alonzo de Santa Cruz was a Spanish cartographer, mapmaker, instrument maker, historian and teacher. He was born about 1505, and died in November 1567. His maps were inventoried in 1572.
